incidents.summary: Capita was fined £14 million for security failings in a March 2023 cyberattack that exposed the personal information of 6.6 million people.

sources.title: Capita fined £14m for data breach affecting over 6m people | ICO
sources.quote: We have issued a fine of £14m to Capita for failing to ensure the security of personal data related to a breach in 2023 that saw hackers steal millions of people’s information.

sources.title: Capita fined £14m for data breach affecting over 6m people | ICO
sources.quote: The personal information of 6.6 million people was stolen, from pension records and staff records to the details of customers of organisations Capita supports.

sources.title: Capita fined £14m for cyber-attack which affected millions - BBC
sources.quote: The proposed £45m fine was taken down to £14m after Capita argued it had made improvements to its cyber-security, offered support for people affected and engaged with other regulators and the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC).
